-- Typed request and runner/service state. JSON is confined to validation and output.
pub type StepDefinition = StepDefinition {
  id: String,
  needs: List(String),
  amount: Int,
  failures: Int
}

pub type Checkpoint = AfterBegin | AfterCall

pub type Command
  = Start(String)
  | Tick(Option(Checkpoint))
  | Advance(Int)
  | Observe
  | Crash
  | Restart
  | Cancel(String)

pub type Workflow = Workflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(Command),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int
}

pub type StepStatus = Pending | Running | StepSucceeded | Failed | Blocked | StepCancelled deriving (Eq)
pub type RunStatus = Active | RunSucceeded | RunFailed | Cancelling | RunCancelled deriving (Eq)

pub type StepState = StepState {
  id: String,
  status: StepStatus,
  attempts: Int,
  ready_at: Int
}

pub type RunState = RunState {
  id: String,
  status: RunStatus,
  cancel_requested: Bool,
  steps: List(StepState)
}

pub type ActionKey = ActionKey { run_id: String, step_id: String }

pub type CallKind = Execute | Lookup deriving (Eq)
pub type CallOutcome = Applied | Replayed | Transient | Found | Missing deriving (Eq)

pub type ServiceCall = ServiceCall {
  key: ActionKey,
  attempt: Int,
  kind: CallKind,
  outcome: CallOutcome
}

pub type Effect = Effect { key: ActionKey, amount: Int }

pub type MockService = MockService {
  calls: List(ServiceCall),
  effects: List(Effect),
  effect_cache: List((ActionKey, Bool))
}

pub type Snapshot = Snapshot { now: Int, up: Bool, runs: List(RunState) }
pub type Simulator = Simulator {
  now: Int,
  up: Bool,
  runs: List(RunState),
  service: MockService,
  observations: List(Snapshot)
}

pub type Action = Action { run: RunState, step: StepState, definition: StepDefinition }

pub fn time_limit() : Int = 2147483647

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

defs.source:
fn select_run(now : Int, inflight : Bool, runs : List(RunState), definitions : List(StepDefinition)) : Option(Action) =
  match runs of
    Nil => None
    Cons(run, rest) =>
      match select_step(now, inflight, run, run.steps, definitions) of
        Some(action) => Some(action)
        None => select_run(now, inflight, rest, definitions)

defs.name: select_cancelling_run
defs.source:
fn select_cancelling_run(now : Int, runs : List(RunState), definitions : List(StepDefinition)) : Option(Action) =
  match runs of
    Nil => None
    Cons(run, rest) =>
      if run_is_cancelling(run) then
        match select_step(now, true, run, run.steps, definitions) of
          Some(action) => Some(action)
          None => select_cancelling_run(now, rest, definitions)
      else select_cancelling_run(now, rest, definitions)

fn select_action(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Option(Action) =
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(action) => Some(action)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)

defs.name: make_running
tick
tick_cancelling
defs.source:
fn tick_cancelling(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN")
  else
    match select_cancelling_run(sim.now, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
      None => Ok(sim)
      Some(action) =>
        let key = ActionKey { run_id = action.run.id, step_id = action.step.id }
        
        match lookup(sim.service, key, action.step.attempts) of
          Ok((service_after_lookup, lookup_outcome)) =>
            let new_step_status = match lookup_outcome of
              Found => StepSucceeded
              Missing => StepCancelled
              _ => StepCancelled
            
            let updated_step = StepState { ..action.step, status = new_step_status }
            let updated_run = RunState { ..action.run, status = RunCancelled, steps = replace_step(action.run, updated_step).steps }
            Ok(replace_run(Simulator { ..sim, service = service_after_lookup }, updated_run))
          Err(_) =>
            Ok(sim)

defs.name: tick_with_checkpoint
defs.source:
fn tick_with_checkpoint(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, checkpoint : Option(Checkpoint)) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN")
  else
    match checkpoint of
      None => 
        if any(\(run) -> run_is_cancelling(run), sim.runs) then
          tick_cancelling(sim, workflow)
        else
          tick(sim, workflow)
      Some(AfterBegin) =>
        if any(\(run) -> run_is_cancelling(run), sim.runs) then
          match select_cancelling_run(sim.now, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
            None => Ok(sim)
            Some(action) =>
              Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = false })
        else
          match select_action(sim, workflow) of
            None => Ok(sim)
            Some(action) =>
              let running = make_running(action.step)
              let begun_run = replace_step(action.run, running)
              let begun = replace_run(sim, begun_run)
              Ok(Simulator { ..begun, up = false })
      Some(AfterCall) =>
        if any(\(run) -> run_is_cancelling(run), sim.runs) then
          match select_cancelling_run(sim.now, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
            None => Ok(sim)
            Some(action) =>
              let key = ActionKey { run_id = action.run.id, step_id = action.step.id }
              match lookup(sim.service, key, action.step.attempts) of
                Ok((service_after_lookup, lookup_outcome)) =>
                  Ok(Simulator { ..sim, service = service_after_lookup, up = false })
                Err(_) =>
                  Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = false })
        else
          match select_action(sim, workflow) of
            None => Ok(sim)
            Some(action) =>
              let running = make_running(action.step)
              let begun_run = replace_step(action.run, running)
              let begun = replace_run(sim, begun_run)
              let key = ActionKey { run_id = action.run.id, step_id = running.id }
              
              match execute(begun.service, key, action.definition.amount, running.attempts, action.definition.failures) of
                Ok((service_after_exec, outcome)) =>
                  Ok(Simulator { ..begun, service = service_after_exec, up = false })
                Err(_) =>
                  Ok(Simulator { ..begun, up = false })

fn run_commands(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, commands : List(Command)) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match commands of
    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(command, rest) =>
      let next = apply_command(sim, workflow, command)?
      run_commands(next, workflow, rest)

defs.name: lookup
defs.source:
fn lookup(service : MockService, key : ActionKey, attempt : Int) : Result((MockService, CallOutcome), String) =
  let has_effect = match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair).run_id == key.run_id && fst(pair).step_id == key.step_id, service.effect_cache) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => false
  let outcome = if has_effect then Found else Missing
  let call = ServiceCall { key = key, attempt = attempt, kind = Lookup, outcome = outcome }
  Ok((MockService { ..service, calls = append(service.calls, [call]) }, outcome))

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: parse_commands
defs.source:
fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

defs.name: handle_request
defs.source:
fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(x) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  match request of
    JObj(fields) =>
      let workflow = parse_workflow(get_field(fields, "input"))?
      simulate(workflow)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.source: fn main() = println(encode(response_json(handle_request(read_line()))))
